studio.title: Lock Studio
studio.applyBlocked: Fix the problems on your screens first.
studio.state.caption: Preview
studio.hint: Drag to move · Shift: no snapping · Alt: one axis · ?: shortcuts
studio.lookHint: Nothing is selected: these settings apply to the whole lock screen. Click a module to edit it.
studio.tip.mugshot: Your picture and name on the lock screen come from your account. Set them with Mugshot.
studio.tip.mugshotMissing: Your picture and name on the lock screen come from your account. Set them with Mugshot: install it with omarchy-pkg-add mugshot, then come back here.
studio.tip.drag: Hold Shift while you drag to place a module freely, and Alt to keep it on one axis.
studio.tip.keys: The arrow keys nudge the selected module one grid step; Ctrl+arrows move it to the next zone.
studio.tip.preview: Any key closes the full-screen preview.
studio.tip.library: Drag a module from this list onto the lock to show it there; drag one from the lock back here to hide it.
studio.tip.look: Click beside the lock, or press Esc, to edit the look as a whole: background, glass and dim.
studio.tip.shortcuts: Press ? to see every keyboard shortcut.
studio.passwordAlways: The password field is always shown.
studio.problem.password-covered: Something covers the password field on %1
studio.problem.password-offscreen: The password field goes off screen on %1
studio.problem.password-high: The password field is in the top third on %1
studio.problem.password-missing: The password field is missing on %1
studio.style.name: Name
studio.dragHint: drag onto the canvas to place it
studio.screensHint: Primary: only on the screen you type the password on.
studio.settingHidesAccount: The lock's settings hide the account (Show user info is off).
studio.settingHidesMedia: The lock's settings hide the media player (Show media is off).
studio.hiddenHint: Hidden. Switch it on, or drag it from the library onto the canvas.
studio.glassLook: As set under Glass and dim
studio.picture.notShown: Not shown: choose Your picture as the source.
studio.picture.missing: The picture is gone: choose it again.
studio.picture.failed: The lock can't show this picture (%1).
studio.pick.title: Choose a picture for the lock screen
studio.pick.NO_SESSION_BUS: The file chooser needs a session bus, and there is none.
studio.pick.PORTAL_FAILED: The file chooser failed. Try again.
studio.pick.UNSUPPORTED: The lock can't use that file: choose a .png, .jpg or .webp picture.
studio.helperUnavailable: This plugin's helper isn't available for this CPU.
studio.drawnHint: Drawn in the theme's colours; it moves only while the lock screen shows.
studio.wallpaperVideo: A video wallpaper without a still frame: the canvas shows the theme colour, as the lock does.
studio.wallpaperMissing: No Omarchy wallpaper found: the canvas shows the theme colour.
studio.blurHint: The wallpaper blurs only with GPU rendering.
studio.decorationHint: A shape behind the modules, fitted to their zones.
studio.dimHint: Darkens the background behind the modules.
studio.glassHint: Behind the media card, the account chip, the field and the decorations.

studio.presetAskBody.one: You have %1 change. Keep it on %2, or replace it with the preset as it comes? Either can be undone.
studio.presetAskBody.other: You have %1 changes. Keep them on %2, or replace them with the preset as it comes? Either can be undone.

studio.presetCantKeep: The lock can't keep these changes on that preset.
studio.reset.title: Reset the look?
studio.reset.body: Go back to the look the lock has now, or start over from the preset %1 without your changes. You can undo either.
studio.reset.savedHint: The look the lock has now.
studio.previewShown: The preview is showing. Click or press any key to close it.
studio.previewHint: Shows this look full screen on the lock's own preview. Nothing is saved.
studio.result.invalid-json: The lock couldn't read the look.
studio.result.locked.apply: The screen is locked, so nothing was saved.
studio.result.locked.preview: The screen is locked, so the preview can't open.
studio.result.unsupported: This version of Omarchy can't save plugin settings.
studio.result.no-entry: Foamy Lock has no entry in shell.json, so there is nowhere to save the look.
studio.result.unexpected: The lock gave an answer Lock Studio doesn't know.
studio.result.not-responding: The Omarchy shell didn't answer. Try again.
studio.result.not-responding.apply: The Omarchy shell didn't answer, so the look may or may not be saved. Try again.
studio.result.not-ready: The Omarchy shell is still starting. Try again in a moment.
studio.result.target-not-found: Foamy Lock isn't loaded in the Omarchy shell.
studio.result.function-not-found: The running Foamy Lock is older than Lock Studio. Restart the Omarchy shell.
studio.result.error: Lock Studio couldn't send the look (%1).
studio.draft.corrupt: The saved draft couldn't be read, so it was set aside. You're starting from the lock's look.
studio.draft.loadFailed: The saved draft couldn't be read (%1).
studio.draft.saveFailed: The draft couldn't be saved (%1). Your changes stay until you quit.
studio.draft.clearFailed: The old draft couldn't be deleted (%1).
studio.restore.title: Continue where you left off?
studio.restore.body: You have changes that aren't applied to the lock yet.
studio.restore.bodyAt: You have changes from %1 that aren't applied to the lock yet.
studio.restore.savedHint: Deletes the draft and starts from the lock's look.
studio.quit.title: Apply your changes before you quit?
studio.quit.body: The lock doesn't have your changes yet. Discard deletes them, and the draft too.
studio.quit.discardHint: Quits without applying and deletes the draft.
studio.wallpaperStill: A video wallpaper: the canvas shows its still frame, as the lock does.
